title: SF-424 R&R Multi-Project Cover
description: SF-424 R&R Multi-Project Cover (RR_SF424_Multi_Project_Cover_4_0) is the cover sheet for each component of a multi-project Research and Related application. It asks the SF-424 (R&R)'s questions with every element optional: submission and application type, applicant organization and contact person, employer identification, applicant type, federal agency and assistance listing, project title and period, congressional district, PD/PI contact information, estimated funding, state review, certification, authorized representative, and optional attachments.
notes: Every element is optional: the XSD gives each element minOccurs="0", and the DAT marks every field Required = No. Resolution: the form requires nothing, and an empty form is valid.

Conditional requirements: the DAT drops R&R's rules that require the Federal Identifier (renewal, continuation, revision), the Previous Grants.gov Tracking ID (changed/corrected), the Other revision explanation, the other agencies, the Other applicant type, the state review date, and a US State and ZIP. It keeps the gray-outs. Resolution: those fields are enabled by the same conditions as on R&R but never required.

Rules that still apply to an answer that is given: a US ZIP needs nine characters (DAT 05-5g, 05-6m, 14-10g, 19-10g), the end date cannot be before the start date (DAT 13-1, 13-2), the congressional district uses the DAT's format, the UEI is 12 characters, and the XSD lengths.

GrantsTrackingNumber: the XSD renames R&R's GGTrackingID and keeps its 13 to 15 character type. DAT 04-2 keeps the label "Previous Grants.gov Tracking ID" and asks for the previous Grants.gov tracking number, so it is the same concept, at application.previous_tracking_id.

Corrected New applications: DAT 01-1 and 04-0 say a changed/corrected New application enters its Grants.gov tracking number in the Federal Identifier, and other types keep their existing identifier. The help for Type of Submission and Federal Identifier says so.

Pre-population: DAT 05-1, 09-0, 10-1, and 10-2 list the UEI, agency name, and assistance listing as applicant-entered fields, where R&R pre-populates them. Resolution: the form pre-populates them read-only, like every SF-424 variant, since a component shares its package's opportunity and applicant.

Signature: DAT 19-14 and 19-15 list the AOR signature and date signed as applicant-entered fields, where R&R post-populates them. Resolution: the form uses the shared certification, which Simpler Grants completes on submission.
The DAT has no forward-population of the PD/PI and AOR organization and address from the applicant, and no default country. The form has neither.

Names and addresses use the XSD's own OptionalHumanNameType and OptionalAddressType, and the applicant organization its OptionalOrganizationType, so first and last name, street, city, and country are optional, and their child elements are in the form's namespace rather than globLib.
AOR Title is optional: the XSD's AORInfoType makes every element optional, unlike R&R, which requires the AOR's title and email.
Certification: I agree is optional. When checked, the answer is true and the XML mapping writes TrustAgree Y: Yes; unchecked, TrustAgree is omitted.
ActivityTitle uses globLib:ProgramActivityTitleDataType rather than R&R's CFDATitleDataType. Both allow 1 to 120 characters.
The XSD places AOR_Signature and AOR_SignedDate after the attachments, unlike R&R. The XML mapping follows the XSD order.
The DAT's prefix list omits "Prof." and its suffix list is "Jr.; Sr.; MD; PhD; JD". Both are comboboxes; the form uses the shared free-text prefix and suffix questions, up to 10 characters.
The definition preview presents the nine legal revision codes in a dropdown. The DAT specifies five checkboxes. The dropdown is a review candidate; its scalar answer already matches the XSD.
Funding line 15c is applicant-entered, following the DAT instruction to enter the total.
risks: This form does not yet exist in SGG, so it will be built from scratch
It reuses the SF-424 (R&R) form's models, made optional, so a change to R&R's questions changes this form too
With nothing required, an applicant can submit an empty component cover; the agency's multi-project instructions decide which answers a component needs
The RevisionCode checkboxes map to combined enum values (AC, AD, BC, BD, E) with valid combinations enforced; this requires custom validation logic
The form has 3 file attachment fields (SFLLL, Pre-application, Cover Letter) that all use AttachedFileDataType

children.label: Type of Submission
children.help_text: To change or correct a New application, enter its Grants.gov tracking ID as the federal identifier. To change or correct any other type, keep its existing federal identifier.

children.label: Date Submitted
children.help_text: Enter the date the application was submitted to the federal agency or state, if applicable.

children.label: Applicant Identifier
children.help_text: Enter the applicant's control number, if applicable.

children.label: 3. Date Received by State / State Application Identifier
Date Received by State
children.help_text: Enter the date the state received the application, if applicable.

children.label: State Application Identifier
children.help_text: Enter the state application identifier, if applicable.

children.label: 4. Federal Identifier / Agency Routing / Grants.gov Tracking
Federal Identifier
children.help_text: Leave this blank for a new application, unless you are changing or correcting it: then enter its Grants.gov tracking ID. For a renewal, continuation, or revision, enter the assigned federal identifier, even if this submission is a correction.

children.label: Agency Routing Identifier
children.help_text: Enter the agency routing number if the funding agency’s instructions provide one.

children.label: Previous Grants.gov Tracking ID
children.help_text: Enter the previous Grants.gov tracking ID, if applicable.

children.label: SAM UEI
children.help_text: Enter the organization's Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) from SAM.gov.
children.pre_populated: SGG supplies this value from the uei provider.

children.help_text: Enter your IRS-assigned EIN or TIN. For a non-US organization, enter 44-4444444.

children.label: Women Owned
children.help_text: Select Yes if women own at least 51% of the business and control and operate it.

children.label: Socially and Economically Disadvantaged
children.help_text: Select Yes if the U.S. Small Business Administration has determined that the business qualifies under section 8(a) of the Small Business Act.

children.label: Type of Application
children.type: Radio group (New, Resubmission, Renewal, Continuation, Revision)

children.label: Revision Type
children.type: Single selection (A, B, C, D, E, AC, AD, BC, BD)
children.help_text: A increases the award, B decreases the award, C increases the duration, and D decreases the duration. Choose AC, AD, BC, or BD if both change. Choose E for Other.

children.label: Other Revision Explanation
children.help_text: Explain the revision if you selected E, Other.

children.label: Is this application being submitted to other agencies?
